mainEntity.name: What does cabin interior sealing cost, and is it worth paying for a professional?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cost depends on how much of the interior needs sealing, how accessible the gaps are, and whether repairs or prep work are needed first. A small targeted job is cheaper than full-home sealing, but the better value usually comes from sealing the largest leak paths instead of chasing every tiny gap.
acceptedAnswer.description: Price depends on the number of gaps, the cabin size, and how hard the problem areas are to reach. Professional sealing is usually worth it when you want cleaner results, better comfort, and fewer repeat fixes.
